<a id="networking"></a>
## Networking

| Resource | Type | Level | Cost | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Beej's Guide to Network Programming](https://beej.us/guide/bgnet/) | book | I | 🆓 free | Free, friendly book on socket programming in C — the best way to understand how network connections really work. |
| [Cloudflare Learning Center](https://www.cloudflare.com/learning/) | article | B | 🆓 free | Short, well-illustrated articles explaining DNS, TLS, DDoS, CDNs and other core Internet concepts. |
| [Julia Evans — Wizard Zines](https://wizardzines.com/) | book | B | ◐ freemium | Illustrated zines that explain networking, DNS, HTTP, Linux and debugging tools in a visual, approachable way. |
| [NetworkChuck](https://www.youtube.com/@NetworkChuck) | youtube-channel | B | 🆓 free | Beginner-friendly YouTube channel on networking, Linux, homelabs and getting started in IT and security. |
| [Practical Networking](https://www.practicalnetworking.net/) | course | B·I | ◐ freemium | Clear explanations of how packets actually move through networks: subnetting, ARP, routing, NAT and TLS. |
| [Professor Messer](https://www.professormesser.com/) | video | B | 🆓 free | Free, complete video courses for CompTIA A+, Network+ and Security+, widely used as a first step into IT and security. |
| [TryHackMe: Pre Security Path](https://tryhackme.com/path/outline/presecurity) | course | B | ◐ freemium | Hands-on beginner path covering networking, the web, Linux and Windows before diving into security. |
| [Wireshark User's Guide](https://www.wireshark.org/docs/wsug_html_chunked/) | documentation | B·I | 🆓 free | Official guide to capturing and analysing traffic with Wireshark, the standard packet analyser. |

<a id="linux"></a>
## Linux

| Resource | Type | Level | Cost | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ⭐ [GTFOBins](https://gtfobins.github.io/) | cheatsheet | I·A | 🆓 free | Curated list of Unix binaries that can be abused to bypass local security restrictions — privilege escalation, file read/write, reverse shells and more. |
| [explainshell](https://explainshell.com/) | tool | B | 🆓 free | Paste any shell command and see each part explained using the matching man-page sections. |
| [Linux Journey](https://linuxjourney.com/) | course | B | 🆓 free | Free, structured lessons that take you from Linux basics to processes, networking and the kernel. |
| [Linux Upskill Challenge](https://linuxupskillchallenge.org/) | course | B | 🆓 free | Free month-long course that teaches practical Linux server administration with daily hands-on tasks. |
| [OverTheWire: Bandit](https://overthewire.org/wargames/bandit/) | lab | B | 🆓 free | Classic beginner wargame that teaches Linux command-line skills through progressively harder SSH levels. |
| [The Linux Command Line (William Shotts)](https://linuxcommand.org/tlcl.php) | book | B | 🆓 free | Free book teaching the Linux shell and command line from first principles to shell scripting. |
| [tldr pages](https://tldr.sh/) | tool | B | 🆓 free | Community-maintained, simplified help pages with practical examples for thousands of command-line tools. |

<a id="windows"></a>
## Windows

| Resource | Type | Level | Cost | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [LOLBAS Project](https://lolbas-project.github.io/) | cheatsheet | I·A | 🆓 free | Catalogue of Windows binaries, scripts and libraries that attackers can abuse, with detection references. |
| [Microsoft Learn: PowerShell](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/) | documentation | B | 🆓 free | Official PowerShell documentation and tutorials, from first commands to scripting and remoting. |
| [SS64 Command Reference](https://ss64.com/) | documentation | B | 🆓 free | Concise command-line reference for Windows CMD, PowerShell, Bash and macOS. |
| [Under The Wire](https://underthewire.tech/) | lab | B | 🆓 free | PowerShell wargames that teach Windows command-line skills through SSH-based levels. |
| [Windows Internals (book)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sysinternals/resources/windows-internals) | book | A | 💲 paid | The definitive reference on how Windows works internally — processes, memory, security and the kernel. |
| [Windows Sysinternals](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sysinternals/) | tool | B·I | 🆓 free | Microsoft's suite of advanced Windows utilities (Process Explorer, Procmon, Autoruns…) essential for troubleshooting and investigations. |

## Programming & Scripting

| Resource | Type | Level | Cost | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Automate the Boring Stuff with Python](https://automatetheboringstuff.com/) | book | B | 🆓 free | Free online book teaching practical Python programming by automating everyday tasks. |

## How the Web Works

| Resource | Type | Level | Cost | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [How HTTPS Works](https://howhttps.works/) | article | B | 🆓 free | A short illustrated comic explaining how HTTPS and TLS keep web traffic private. |

## Security Concepts

| Resource | Type | Level | Cost | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ⭐ [CyberChef](https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef/) | tool | B·I | 🆓 free | GCHQ's 'Cyber Swiss Army Knife' for encoding, decoding, encryption, compression and data analysis in the browser. |
